Guidance: Guiding moral, professional, and behavioral values agreed upon by the team.
Collective vision articulating the team's commitment to delivering quality project outcomes.
Standard rules governing daily conduct, accountability, punctuality, and mutual respect.
Agreed overlapping collaboration hours, remote working standards, and response timeframes.
Protocols for daily standups, status meetings, retrospectives, agendas, and note taking.
Guidelines defining appropriate use of instant messaging, email, ticketing, and documentation repositories.
Agreed decision methodology (e.g., consensus, majority vote, or technical lead authority).
Constructive step-by-step process for resolving interpersonal and technical disputes.
Formal acknowledgment and commitment signed by all active project team members.
